22672.subject: Mathematics
22672.question_text: In the diagram above, |PQ| = |PR| = |RS| and ∠RPS = 32°. Find the value of ∠QPR
22672.explanation:
From the figure, < PSR = 32° (base angles of an isos. triangle)

\(\therefore\) < PRS = 180° - (32° + 32°) = 116° (sum of angles in a triangle)

< QRP = 180° - 116° = 64° (angle on a straight line)

< PQR = 64° (base angles of an isos. triangle)

< QPR = 180° - (64° + 64°) = 52°

22701.subject: Mathematics
22701.question_text:
Two groups of male students cast their votes on a particular proposal. The result are as follows:

  In favor Against
Group A 128 32
Group B 96 48

If a student in favor of the proposal is selected for a post, what is the probability that he is from group A?
22701.explanation:
Probability that a student in favor is group A

= \(\frac{128}{128 + 32 + 96 + 48}\)

= \(\frac{128}{304}\)

= \(\frac{8}{19}\)

  In favor Against
Group A 128 32
Group B 96 48

If a student is chosen at random, what is probability that he is against the proposal?
22702.explanation:
Probability that the student is against the proposal

= \(\frac{32 + 48}{128 + 32 + 96 + 48}\)

= \(\frac{80}{304}\)

= \(\frac{5}{19}\)

56104.question_text:
The annual salary of Mr. Johnson Mohammed for 1989 was N12,000.00. He spent this on agriculture projects, education of his children, food items, saving , maintenance and miscellaneous items as shown in the pie chart

How much did he spend on food items?
56104.explanation:
Degree for food items = 360° - (120° + 80° + 43° + 30° + 18°)

= 360° - 291°

= 69°

∴∴ Amount spent on food items = \(\frac{69}{360}\)×12,000.00

= N2300.00
